The algorithm determines which nodes to render in detail and which to approximate [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that the technique uses 'error-controlled approximations' where 'nodal regions with smooth data will be rendered by an approximation technique' and that 'a future implementation is planned to support a mixture of rendering modes, with some nodal regions being approximated by the model and others being rendered in detail'. The current implementation stops traversal and draws the nodal region (approximation) if the error is below a threshold or it is a leaf, while continuing traversal (to potentially render children in detail) if the error is high and the node is not a leaf. Thus, the algorithm determines which nodes to render in detail (by traversing deeper) and which to approximate (by stopping and drawing the nodal model).
